digestScope: canonical JSON of contractVersion, wireRevision, and cases with recursively sorted object keys

cases.summary: Authenticated discovery reports supported revisions, server identity, and capabilities.
A July 28 request succeeds with required per-request metadata.
assertions: optional client metadata validated when present

cases.summary: A supported 2025-era client completes its initialization flow and then succeeds.
An unsupported revision returns the official unsupported-version error.
A July 28 client can make an independent request without initialization.
Missing static bearer authentication is rejected without OAuth discovery.
Invalid static bearer authentication is rejected with invalid_token.
assertions: HTTP 403 reserved for authenticated policy denial

cases.summary: A bogus legacy session header cannot restore, bind, or stall work.
Tool listing is deterministic and carries July 28 cache metadata.
Tool calls return complete typed results with server identity.
Client disconnect stops safe request-scoped work or transfers it durably.
assertions: work cancelled when safe or durably transferred

cases.summary: A server restart does not create a reconnection-state requirement.
Work beyond the synchronous ceiling ends loudly and safely.
Health is public but contains no sensitive request or credential data.
Host and Origin validation use explicit configuration allowlists.
Legacy SSE is deliberately supported or clearly reported as removed.
assertions: supported path works or removed path fails clearly

cases.summary: Proxy and bridge paths preserve protocol behavior without production mutation.
Every July 28 Streamable HTTP POST validates method and name headers.
July 28 subscriptions and supported older GET behavior are tested separately.
assertions: legacy GET and notification behavior covered separately

cases.summary: The historical Server not initialized sequence never hangs.
Both repositories carry the same versioned contract and digest.
assertions: cross-repository equality reviewed in coordinated changes
